titleCard.headline: 给下拉起对名字
titleCard.lede: 往下展开只是外观。先定提交模型。

closeCard.headline: 说清楚
closeCard.lede: 分组选择是分类，级联选择才是上下级。先说名称、场景、面板何时关闭，再谈外观。

titleCard.headline: Name the dropdown
titleCard.lede: Opening downward is only the skin. First decide the commit model.

closeCard.headline: Say it this way
closeCard.lede: Grouped is filing. Cascader is parent-child. Name the model, the scene, and when the panel closes — then talk about looks.

lines.zh: 给下拉起对名字。往下展开只是外观，真正要先定的是提交模型。
lines.en: Name the dropdown properly. Opening downward is only the skin. First decide the commit model.

lines.zh: 选择，扁平列表里只交一个值，点中即关。
lines.en: Select commits one value from a flat list, and closes on pick.

lines.zh: 多选择交的是一个集合。面板保持开着，标签可以单独摘掉。
lines.en: Multi-select commits a set. The panel stays open, and chips can be removed one by one.

lines.zh: 分组选择仍然只交一个值。分组标题只是分类，不是层级。
lines.en: Grouped Select still commits one value. Group titles are filing, not hierarchy.

lines.zh: 级联选择必须走到叶子才提交一条路径。父级只展开，不能当成最终值。
lines.en: Cascader must reach a leaf before it commits a path. A parent only expands. It is not the final value.

lines.zh: 分割按钮的主体立刻执行默认动作，只有箭头才打开低频菜单。
lines.en: On a Split Button, the body fires the default action at once. Only the chevron opens the infrequent menu.

lines.zh: 巨型导航不是表单值，是多列导航。点链接，或点其它导航项。
lines.en: A Mega Menu is not a form value. It is multi-column navigation. Click a link, or another nav item.

lines.zh: 日期选择先入住再离店，过去不可选。两端齐了才是一段，晚数是日历日差。
lines.en: A date range is check-in, then check-out. Past days are locked. Only both ends make a span. Nights are calendar days.

lines.zh: 最容易混的一对：分组选择是分类，级联选择才是上下级。先说名称、场景和规则，再谈外观。
lines.en: The pair people mix up: Grouped is filing. Cascader is parent-child. Name it, name the scene, name the rule, then talk about looks.
